AGNES BIRTHDAY — NEW 10-PHOTO FINALE

Paste ONLY the new finale photos into this folder.

Recommended filenames:
  finale-01.jpg
  finale-02.jpg
  finale-03.jpg
  finale-04.jpg
  finale-05.jpg
  finale-06.jpg
  finale-07.jpg
  finale-08.jpg
  finale-09.jpg
  finale-10.jpg

You may also use:
  .jpeg
  .png
  .webp

The website automatically tries JPG, JPEG, PNG and WebP for every number.
Example: finale-01.png will work even though the data file says finale-01.jpg.

Recommended photo format:
  Portrait photos: 4:5 or 3:4
  Minimum size: 1200 × 1500 pixels
  Keep the face near the centre
  Do not add the old photo-01.jpg files here

To change a memory title:
  Open src/data/memories.js
  Edit the title inside the finalePhotos list.

The existing website photos remain in public/photos.
This final cinematic section uses ONLY public/finale-photos.
